digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review on-ramp documentation and CLI/MCP explain interface
propositions: Authors lack discoverable, concise on-ramp documentation for writing plans that pass the plan-review gate; existing materials are either gate mechanics or reviewer-facing criterion registries.
Authors lack discoverable on-ramp documentation for passing code-review (LLM-Review + Verified gates) and mispointers in AGENTS.md direct them to the criterion registry instead of author guides.
The CLI/MCP explain interface needs to expose author-guide names (rebar explain plan, rebar explain review) in addition to criterion IDs via a shared registry lookup.

Two new hand-written prose docs must be created (writing-a-passing-plan.md, passing-code-review.md) distinct from generated registry content, and linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate.
The explain path (library registry.explain_guide, CLI _llm_commands explain routes, MCP explain_criterion) must handle unknown guide names and missing files with structured error responses.
